plan: Inspect existing Android Cloud Backup bootstrap and Rust persisted Dirty/retryable Failed/stale Uploading resume paths.
Add a narrow network-constrained Android WorkManager worker that calls the existing Rust resume path instead of duplicating upload semantics.
Keep consent, passkey and recovery prompts out of background execution; preserve authorization-required/quota/offline state for foreground reconciliation.
Test no-pending-work exit, persisted retryable work after process recreation, network constraint, and unchanged foreground startup/resume behavior.
Treat transport completion as insufficient; foreground-visible durable cloud state remains the semantic authority.
Replace the Android foreground Service/manual PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK queue lifecycle with WorkManager work while leaving the JS-facing API stable.
Map progress through WorkManager progress/WorkInfo observation and preserve durable download identity across process death.
Use WorkManager constraints and bounded retry/backoff without treating retryability as idempotency or completion as durable file effect.
Test enqueue/cancel/progress/complete/error compatibility, process-death recovery, duplicate scheduling, connectivity transition and retry exhaustion.
Keep iOS and unrelated application behavior outside the change scope.
Reconcile the issue text against current SyncCatchUpWorker/SyncForegroundService/scheduler implementation before proposing any patch.
Only change a demonstrably missing acceptance criterion; do not duplicate already-landed catch-up scheduling.
Verify mutual exclusion, bounded slice, persisted lastSyncedAt, reboot persistence and background-sync preference coupling if a current gap remains.
